title: Answer: what would change its mind

statements.text: No observation can refute the principle itself, which is mathematics. What can fail is a specific generative model or process theory, whose predictions can be refuted by data, or a step in the derivation, which can be shown wrong.

sources.quote: the FEP is not falsifiable as a mathematical statement, but it may as well be falsifiable to the extent that its postulates refer to a specific class of empirical phenomena that the principle aims to describe.
